claim_ceiling: Campaign plan only. This manifest contains no raw acoustic or visual measurements, no reproduced paper data, no physical duct measurements and no robot qualification.

evaluation_scope.task_tolerance_policy: freeze_per_application_before_evaluation; never infer from the paper threshold

ground_truth.method: Analytic deterministic trajectory truth for L1; independent metrology or surveyed encoder for later rig profiles.
ground_truth.independence: The reference oracle is separate from candidate estimator output and does not consume its asserted position or confidence.

scenarios.name: Clean monotonic motion with adequate anchors
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Accept only when the independent chainage oracle and all required sensor/anchor revisions agree within the preregistered tolerance.

scenarios.name: Visual drift corrected by intermittent acoustic observations
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare all ablations against exact truth; preserve acoustic update timing and do not treat a fused estimate as truth.

scenarios.name: Repeated-joint acoustic alias
perturbations: multiple similar echo patterns at distinct chainages
scenarios.oracle_requirement: The verifier must detect that multiple locations remain plausible; a single confident point estimate is rejected.

scenarios.name: Feature-sparse visual stream
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report modality-specific degradation and show whether independent acoustic/odometric observations restore the task tolerance.

scenarios.name: Acoustic dropout with inertial bias and wheel slip
scenarios.oracle_requirement: No overconfident extrapolation during the unobservable interval; measure drift and reacquisition after recovery.

scenarios.name: Sensor timebase mismatch
perturbations: deliberate clock offset beyond declared tolerance
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject incompatible or stale synchronization evidence; do not repair timestamps silently.

scenarios.name: Wrong or stale route anchor
perturbations: anchor belongs to another route segment
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Local chainage may remain reportable, but global placement must be rejected and route authority preserved.

scenarios.name: Unobserved segment with no independent reference
perturbations: sensor observations absent in a bounded interval
no surveyed anchor spans the interval
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve the unobserved interval and refuse to make a precise location claim across it.

scenarios.name: Cable-duct domain shift: material and occupancy
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Treat as an unqualified population until measurements and calibration are collected on this exact duct profile.

scenarios.name: Wet and debris-contaminated cable-duct profile
perturbations: controlled water film or pooled water
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not transfer clean/dry results; preserve invalid visibility and acoustic-quality states.

scenarios.name: False loop closure and direction reversal
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Independent chronology and topology checks must reject an impossible route transition or unsupported loop closure.

scenarios.name: Correlated multi-sensor degradation
perturbations: water and fouling jointly degrade acoustic and visual channels
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not multiply independent sensor reliabilities when a common cause invalidates multiple modalities.

global_controls: Every estimate binds exact input, sensor, calibration, firmware, route-anchor and fixture revisions.
No unknown, unobserved or unusable interval may be promoted to a clear location claim.
All failed, aborted and manually recovered trials remain in the denominator.
A 1D chainage estimate never implies 2D or 3D pose accuracy.
The independent oracle does not consume the candidate estimator's asserted position or confidence.
The 0.5 m paper comparison threshold is not a universal cable-duct acceptance threshold.

data_rights.required_action: Request the author's data and record the response, permitted uses, attribution terms and redistribution constraints before reproduction or publication.
